text: Chapter 2 had one job: take everything the earlier three courses already taught, and drill it from the DP-700 exam's specific angle. Nothing here was new technology.

Lessons 26-27 covered what DP-700 is and its three near-even domains. Lessons 28-30 drilled each domain directly. Lessons 31-36 were six practice-question sets, and Lesson 37 named the five trap patterns behind them.
Lesson 38 turned the domain map into a four-week study schedule. Lesson 39 gave you exam-day mechanics. Lessons 40 and 41 put all of it to work in an eighteen-question mock exam.
The recurring pattern across every practice set: DP-700 rewards the narrowest correct control or tool over a broader one that would also technically work.
Chapter 2 is complete. Next up: Chapter 3, AI for Data Engineers — starting with Copilot in Fabric.
